feature: Interior Visibility can cover a rectangle with two corner selections. Selecting a fully covered rectangle uncovers it. Each complete rectangle is one undoable native edit.
checks: First corner does not modify source.
Corners may be selected in either order.
One undo/redo handles the complete rectangle.
Other covered areas survive rectangle removal.
Cancel and changing tools discard the pending corner.
Terrain and other campaign content stay unchanged.
Real 32×24 Three Courts project: six corner selections recreate its 170 authored hidden cells.
Saved edited project compiles and reaches native visibility metadata in both 1P and 2P.
English and Brazilian Portuguese actual rendered editor runs pass.
additional_fixes: Map tile icon padding no longer consumes the artwork on large maps.
Small covered cells use compact dots rather than overlapping labels.
Corner label is an overlay so it cannot widen a grid column.
Back to Setup label is translated in all three editor languages.
limits: This validates desktop rendering and native authoring/player paths, not a new physical Android-device acceptance run.
Large multi-room console rendering remains pending; this does not lift the N64 export limit.
